subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3: Renewable Energy – Project: An Invention Powered by Renewable Energy
outcomes: Use presentation language to start and end a talk.
Plan an invention that uses renewable energy.
Give polite feedback and ask questions.

tf.s: 'Good morning, everyone' is a good way to start a presentation.
'Thank you for listening' is used at the start of a presentation.
tf.why: We say it at the end.

tf.s: In this project, the invention must run on renewable energy.
tf.why: Correct, the competition asks for an eco-friendly invention.

tf.s: The invention in this project must have two purposes.
tf.why: Right, that is one of the criteria.

tf.s: A good slide has a lot of long text and no pictures.
tf.why: Good slides use clear pictures and short text.

tf.s: 'Our invention is called…' introduces the name of the invention.
tf.why: Well done, that is how we name it.

tf.s: Feedback should always be rude so people improve faster.
A poster can include a title, a picture, the advantages and the purpose.
tf.why: Yes, these make a clear poster.

tf.s: A presentation does not need an introduction.
tf.why: A clear introduction helps the audience.

tf.s: 'What energy does it use?' is a good question about an invention.
tf.why: Correct, it asks about an important detail.

boxes.q: How do you start a presentation?
What energy must the invention use?
boxes.why: The project is about renewable energy.

boxes.q: How can you make slides attractive?
boxes.why: Short text and pictures are easy to follow.

o: Your idea is clear. You could speak louder.
boxes.why: Say a strength, then a suggestion.

boxes.q: Which is a good question for a team?

o: The audience can follow the talk.

mcq.why: We thank the audience at the end.

mcq.q: What are the two criteria for the invention?
o: It runs on renewable energy and has two purposes.
It is very big and uses oil.
It is cheap and uses coal.
a title, a picture, the advantages and the purpose
mcq.why: These help people understand the invention.

mcq.q: Complete: 'The main ___ is that it uses solar power.'
mcq.why: Using solar power is a good point.

mcq.q: Your team invents a bag that charges phones with sunlight. Which sentence introduces it?
mcq.why: 'Our invention is called…' gives the name.

mcq.q: You liked a team's idea but they spoke quietly. What do you say?
o: Your idea is clear. You could speak louder.
mcq.why: Give a strength and a polite suggestion.

mcq.q: Why must the invention use renewable energy in this project?
o: Because the competition requires an eco-friendly invention.
Because coal is not allowed in schools.
Because it is the cheapest to build always.
mcq.why: The project is about clean, renewable energy.

mcq.q: Which slide is easiest for the audience to follow?
o: a slide with a clear picture and short text
a slide full of small text
a slide with ten different colours of text

mcq.q: Why is it useful to accept feedback after a presentation?
o: It helps you find points to improve.
It means you get no questions.
mcq.why: Feedback shows what to do better next time.
